  ITEM 3:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-21-17
  • 2133 West Valley Boulevard
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to allow
  an on-premise alcoholic beverage license (Type 41) for the sale of
  beer and wine in conjunction with meal service in an existing
  restaurant located in the Valley Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan
  (VSP) zone. (This item is exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act)
  • Recommended Action: Continue to November 15, 2021.
  • Assistant Planner Werner Abrego provided staff presentation.
  • Public Comments: There were none.
  • Commissioner Comments: None
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Conditional Use Permit CUP-21-17
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu. Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea

 ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-40, CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT CUP-20-04 AND LOT MERGER LOTM-21-01

  •  1318-1322 West Alhambra Road
  •  Request: This is a request for a Planned Development Permit,
  Conditional Use Permit and a Lot Merger to allow a meditation center
  and a single-family residence to occupy an existing 5,000 square foot
  building that was previously a market on an approximate land area of
  16,500 square feet located in the R-2 (Limited Multiple Family
  Residential) zone. (This item is exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act)
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 21-27, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-21-40, Conditional Use Permit CUP-
  20-04 and Lot Merger LOTM-21-01, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  •  Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided staff presentation.
  •  Tong Jue Si, Applicant, was available for questions accompanied by
  a City-appointed interpreter, Charlene Shih of Language Network, Inc.
  •  Public Comments: There was 36 letters read into the record and one
  person spoke on the project. Those in opposition of the project had
  concerns with the intent of the owner, the smell of incense, automobile
  and pedestrian traffic, and large parties taking place onsite.
  •  Commissioner Comments:
  President Gardea asked about what kind of events would take place.
  Commissioner Wang asked for clarification with the term large
  parties and what future actions would trigger Planning Commission
  approval.
  Commissioner Tsujii asked about how many people would be
  working/volunteering there beyond the three monks living onsite.
  Vice President Garcia had concerns with the raised planter bed.
  Commissioner Sahu asked for clarification on multiple subjects and
  had concerns with the services that could be performed by the
  applicant.
  Commissioners had concerns regarding the full extent of services that
  could take place onsite and the maximum number of people that could
  attend a service.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Planned Development Permit PD-21-40, Conditional
  Use Permit CUP-20-04 and Lot Merger LOTM-21-01 with an amendment
  to Condition PL8 and PL16, and removal of Condition PL11.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu. Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0
